pages.title: Day & Boarding School in Geneva Switzerland
blocks: Collège du Léman (CDL) is a warm, welcoming, and truly international day and boarding school in Geneva, where every child shapes their own journey to success.
A LEARNING JOURNEY MADE FOR YOU

We know that every child has unique strengths, ambitions, and interests. That’s why, at Collège du Léman (CDL), we empower our students to shape their own learning journey, guided by our world-class teachers. Your child will choose from an unparalleled breadth of diplomas, learn in different languages, and immerse themselves in exciting opportunities. This will inspire them to be their very best, every single day.

Every child's path is different. In a community of more than 120 nationalities, we help students develop the grounding, confidence and perspective to discover who they are and be ready for what comes next.

Choice is key at Collège du Léman (CDL), and we offer a wide range of internationally respected curricula, qualifications, and diplomas that give every student the opportunity to excel. In High School , for example, your child will follow one of five distinct pathways , which include the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP), IB Career-related Programme (IBCP), American High School Diploma, French Baccalaureate, and Swiss Maturité. As well as being packed with innovative learning experiences , our programmes are taught in either French, English, or a combination of the two, meaning your child will study in the language that suits them best. Our ‘Made for You’ approach ensures every student is happy, engaged and empowered to achieve outstanding results . With personalised support and a choice of five diplomas, your child will be ready to shape their own future, with pathways to prestigious universities such as Oxford and University College London.
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE
FLOURISHING IN AND BEYOND THE CLASSROOM
Our globally respected curricula – created by world-leading experts – reimagines learning through our six core educational pillars.

Our school is home to extraordinarily talented teachers from around the world. With a wealth of experience and specialist qualifications – and a genuine passion for sharing knowledge in a way that works for every child – they inspire, challenge, and nurture our students’ skills.

We think beyond traditional education to enable every student to shape their own unique learning journey. Our ‘Made for You’ philosophy guarantees choice, nurtures strengths, and fosters a lifelong love of learning. It also develops confident, resilient, and compassionate young people.

We unlock the joy of learning at Collège du Léman. Through an incredible breadth of experiences – from international expeditions and private music lessons to more than 100 extracurricular clubs – your child will discover their strengths and passions. They’ll do all this in a community where they feel safe, supported, and challenged.

At Collège du Léman, our students discover their place in the world – and use their energy, enthusiasm, and skills to make a real difference. We celebrate diversity and inclusion here, which will inspire your child to become a compassionate, open-minded global citizen.

Large in scale yet small in feel, our closeknit multicultural community of more than 120 nationalities is truly special. We’re a school where everyone thrives, and as part of the Nord Anglia global family, a place where students create powerful connections that last a lifetime.

Spanning more than 50 acres, our beautiful campus is brimming with outdoor spaces that burst with life and colour. Here, outstanding facilities inspire our students to get active and creative, as well as playing host to innovative learning experiences enhanced by technology.

Collège du Léman is so much more than a school. For our boarders, we're a home away from home, a second family, and a place where students receive 24/7 care, support, and inspiration. In our inclusive community, your child will make friends for life, enjoy amazing activities outside of school, and develop the values and 21st century skills they need to be the very best version of themselves.

We can’t wait to welcome your family to Collège du Léman day and boarding school.

We’re delighted you’re considering Collège du Léman for your child’s education. Our warm and caring international community is the perfect place for your child to shape their personal and academic journey to success , empowered by our world-class teachers United by our RISE values of Respect, Internationalism, Spirit, and Excellence, everyone is welcome here – and we'll make sure your family quickly feels at home.
talk to THE CDL ADMISSIONS team

We know that finding the right school for your child is such an important step. The Collège du Léman admissions team is here to help. They’ll guide you through our requirements , answer any questions, and make sure you have the information you need.
Get in touch with the CDL admissions team today – fill in our online enquiry form, give us a call, or send an email.
Join us for a personalised tour of our campus – or a virtual discovery meeting.
We’ll walk you through our step-by-step admissions process.
We recommend getting in touch with us first, but, if you'd like, you're welcome to go ahead and fill out our online application form.
THE COLLÈGE DU LÉMAN ADMISSIONS JOURNEY
Ready to start your application ? Here's what you need to do next.
Your child’s admissions journey officially starts with our online enquiry form. Interested in boarding? Let us know!

You can join us for a tour at any point in your admissions journey. We’d love to show you around our beautiful campus, where you’ll meet our exceptional educators and get a feel for our buzzing international community. If you can’t make it to Geneva, we’ll happily arrange a one-to-one virtual discovery meeting.

Upon completing our online application form, you’ll need to send us some supporting documents. Prospective boarders also have to complete a video questionnaire . To finalise the application step you'll then need to pay a non-refundable application fee of CHF 500 per student. Finally, your child's current school will need to fill in our confidential report form - please send the link to the form to the respective teacher or principal.

Our academic and pastoral teams will review your application and identify whether your child needs any extra learning support. This takes five working days. If we have spaces available, we’ll write to you offering your child a place.

Once we’ve formally enrolled your child and you’ve paid our fees, we’ll confirm their start date. We’ll also send you a welcome pack containing all the information you need to prepare for your child's first day.
EXPLORE CDL FROM THE COMFORT OF HOME

The best way to get a feel for our thriving school community is to visit our campus. Can't make it to Geneva? Not a problem. Our virtual tour will guide you around our classrooms, sports facilities , and specialist spaces – all from the comfort of home.

Our flexible admissions process is designed around your schedule. We’ll take the time to answer your questions, show you around, and introduce you to our Principals and teachers.

pages.title: Social Purpose & Community Service | Collège du Léman
blocks: Our students discover their place in our world – and go on to change it for the better. Inspired by life-changing trips, hands-on service activities, and CV-boosting leadership opportunities, your child will make a real difference in school, our community, and across the globe.

We’re proud to be an international school in the fullest sense. We promote global citizenship through our REACH programme, which nurtures Responsible, Eco-friendly, Active, Creative, and Healthy behaviours. Students also take part in activities that benefit the school community – and develop a host of transferable skills in the process. Our International Week and Language Diversity Festival celebrate our internationalism, too, bringing our community together and opening our students’ minds to different cultures and languages.

Our students use their energy and enthusiasm to support the causes that matter to them – both here and across the globe. This includes projects like our annual Gift Box appeal, which supplies essentials to children in need across Europe, as well as charities such as IKOKU, which provides clean water, sanitation, and medical support to communities in Kenya and South Sudan. Closer to home, our students fight hunger and food waste through Partage, a local food bank, and get hands-on to keep Lake Geneva clean.

Embodying our RISE values of Respect, Internationalism, Spirit, and Excellence, your child will work as team, solve complex problems, and communicate effectively as part of our Student Government, High Honour Society, and House leadership groups. Our Eco Committee and Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Committee promote citizenship and social contribution, too.

Our partnership with UNICEF opens our students’ eyes to pressing global issues – and encourages them to develop their own sense of purpose. Your child will explore topics ranging from the UN Sustainable Development Goals to climate change, taking part in collaborative projects on our Global Campus platform and through our Model United Nations club. Researching, debating, and proposing solutions to some of the biggest challenges facing our planet, your child will grow in confidence, broaden their horizons, and make powerful lifelong connections.

At Collège du Léman, every student shapes their own academic journey. Our ‘Made for You’ approach nurtures strengths and passions, and fosters a lifelong love of learning, while simultaneously developing confident, resilient, and compassionate young people.
